sections.name: 惊喜 / 跳过 / 收集（通用部分） · Surprise layer (shared)

entries.zh: 有东西藏起来了，找找看。
entries.en: Something just hid. Can you find it?

entries.zh: 再找到 {n} 个，最后的彩蛋就开了。
entries.en: {n} more, and the last surprise opens.

entries.zh: 都找到了。还有一个彩蛋。
entries.en: You found them all. One more surprise.
Up in the sky, by a cloud.

entries.zh: 这些花瓣好像在请我们再往前走走。
entries.en: These petals seem to be asking us to keep walking.
Off you go, stinky little cat

entries.zh: 一直往右走，尽头有东西等你。
entries.en: Keep walking right. Something is waiting at the end.

entries.zh: 按住 ▶ 走 · 轻点 ▲ 跳
entries.en: Hold ▶ to walk · tap ▲ to jump
Roll up, roll up — don’t miss it!
Modelled by hand, printed in colour.

entries.zh: 在小台灯下敲电脑，头顶两个黄色的“??”。
entries.en: Typing away under a little desk lamp, two yellow “??” overhead.

entries.zh: 捧着写着“Eblana!”的书，头顶冒出一个“!!”。
entries.en: Holding a book that says “Eblana!”, with a “!!” of surprise.

entries.zh: 敲电脑的小猪，压成浮雕，贴在薄荷色底板上。
entries.en: The pig at the laptop, pressed into a relief on a mint plate.

entries.zh: 捧着书的小猫，浮雕在薰衣草色底板上。
entries.en: The cat with the book, in relief on a lavender plate.

entries.zh: Notion 完整版：吊杆麦克风、「??」、小盆栽——拆开看每一色。
entries.en: The complete Notion build: boom mic, “??”, pot — explode to see every colour.

entries.zh: Notion 完整版：书、手机、多肉、「!!」——拆开看每一色。
entries.en: The complete Notion build: book, phone, succulent, “!!” — explode the colours.

entries.zh: 浮雕冰箱贴。拆色后翻到背面，能看到两个磁铁槽。
entries.en: Relief magnet. Split colours, then flip to see the two magnet pockets on the back.

entries.zh: 浮雕冰箱贴。拆色后翻到背面，能看到两个磁铁槽。
entries.en: Relief magnet. Split colours, then flip to see the two magnet pockets on the back.

entries.zh: 燕尾榫把它们扣在一起，接缝上的两个半颗心，合成一颗。
entries.en: A dovetail joins them; the two half hearts on the seam become one.

entries.zh: 一间小店。小臭猫走过五件小东西，走向一扇黑黑的后门。
entries.en: A little shop. The stinky little cat walks past five little things towards a dark back door.

sections.name: 2b 桌上（小店的 AR 支线） · AR side room

entries.en: Let’s set them on the table.

entries.zh: 牵着手走吧，这条夜路我陪你。
entries.en: Let’s walk it together. I’ll stay with you on this night path.

entries.zh: 按住前进，挑一条路，别回头。
entries.en: Hold to walk. Choose a way. Don’t look back.

entries.zh: 按住屏幕前进 · 拖动环顾 · 点发光的 ??
entries.en: Hold the screen to walk · drag to look · tap a glowing ??

entries.zh: 按住 W / ↑ 前进 · 拖动环顾 · 点发光的 ?? · M 地图 · B 回头
entries.en: Hold W / ↑ to walk · drag to look · click a glowing ?? · M map · B turn back

entries.zh: 照木牌上的顺序，碰一碰蘑菇。
entries.en: Tap the mushrooms in the sign’s order.

entries.zh: 世界屁股日是什么时候？

entries.en: Hint: the day after May Day.
The lock gives way on its own.

entries.zh: 夜里的方块森林小路，透过摄像机看到的画面。
entries.en: A dark blocky forest path at night, seen through a camcorder.

entries.zh: 点一个去过的地方，快进过去。
entries.en: Tap a place you’ve been to fast-forward there.

entries.zh: 五张 ?? 贴纸集齐了！大门后面有什么在发粉光……
entries.en: All five ?? stickers! Something pink is glowing past the gate…

entries.zh: “我们的第一天，月份写在前面……”
entries.en: “our first day, the month comes first…”

entries.zh: 拿到一根蜡烛。隧道没那么黑了。
entries.en: Got a candle. The tunnel won’t be so dark now.

entries.zh: 门锁着。这屋里的八音盒也许会唱首歌……
entries.en: The door is locked. The music box in here might know a song…

entries.zh: 太黑了进不去。要是有根蜡烛就好了。
entries.en: Too dark to go in. A candle would help.

entries.zh: 一堵粉色的灌木墙，上面缺了几张 ?? 贴纸（{n}/5）。
entries.en: A wall of pink bushes. Its ?? stickers are missing ({n}/5).

entries.zh: 灌木咯咯笑着把你推了回来。
entries.en: The bushes giggle and push you back.

entries.zh: 床单小鬼害羞地挥了挥手。
蝙蝠！小小的、吱吱叫的蝙蝠。
又是三条路。其中一条在发粉光……
entries.en: Three ways again. One of them glows pink…

entries.zh: 听八音盒唱一段，再照着弹出来。
entries.en: Listen to the music box, then play it back.

entries.zh: 八音盒唱起来了。哪里的门咔哒开了。
entries.en: The music box sings. A door clicks open somewhere.

entries.zh: 把九根蜡烛全点亮。点一根，旁边的也会跟着变。
entries.en: Light all nine candles. Each flame lights its neighbours too.

entries.zh: 九根都亮了。地穴打开了。
entries.en: All nine burning. The crypt opens.
The gate wants our day one.
The torn notes have the digits.
The driver was me. Hop on.
The bus doors open… who’s driving?

entries.zh: 每一张 ?? 都是我。最好的结局，是你。
entries.en: Every ?? was me. The best ending is you.

entries.zh: 萤火虫在树屋周围围成了一颗心。
entries.en: Fireflies make a heart around the tree house.

entries.zh: ?? 贴纸 {n}/5 —— 集齐有隐藏结局
entries.en: {n}/5 ?? stickers — collect them all for the hidden ending
Near the jelly, on the right.

entries.zh: 到这儿就安心了。要不要玩一会儿？
entries.en: It’s safe here. Want to play for a bit?

entries.zh: 三件可以拉扯的果冻标本：双髻鲨、小猪与猫，在浏览器里实时模拟。
entries.en: Three soft-body jelly studies — a hammerhead, a pig and a cat — simulated live in the browser.

entries.zh: 果冻{name}。拖动拉伸，滚轮扭转。
entries.en: Jelly {name}. Drag to stretch, scroll to twist.

entries.en: Drag to pull · Scroll to twist

entries.en: Drag to pull · Two fingers to twist

entries.en: Open in a recent Chrome, Safari or Edge.

entries.zh: 有一颗星星颜色不一样。
entries.en: One star is a different colour.

entries.zh: 长春的天空。两百天，也都在这上面。
entries.en: The sky over Changchun. Two hundred days are up there too.
Below the buttons, on the right.
Want to play a round together?
Go back to the first page

entries.zh: 林子深处开始亮起来了。
entries.en: Something is beginning to glow deeper in the woods.

entries.zh: ← →  漫步     再往前走还有东西
按住或拖动就能走 · 慢慢看
entries.en: Hold or drag to walk · take your time

entries.zh: 天暗了下来。这些蘑菇，一盏一盏的。
entries.en: It’s gotten dark. The mushrooms are lighting the way, one by one.
There’s a warm light ahead. A window is glowing.

entries.zh: ← →  漫步     跟着微光继续走
按住或拖动就能走 · 跟着微光
entries.en: Hold or drag to walk · follow the glow
Low on the left, near the floor.

entries.zh: 这里有一间空房子诶，我们可以布置一下
entries.en: Oh — an empty house. We could furnish it.

entries.zh: 把手机横过来，布置我们的小家
entries.en: Turn your phone sideways to furnish our little home
That’s okay, I’ll try it like this

entries.zh: 先选一件，再点地板放下。拖动摆位置 · 旋转 90° · 拿掉
entries.en: Pick something, then tap the floor. Drag to move · rotate 90° · remove

entries.zh: 之前的布置是平面贴纸，和新的立体房间对不上，已经为你清空。请重新摆放。
entries.en: Your earlier layout was flat stickers and cannot map into this room, so it was cleared. Please place things again.

entries.zh: 这台设备无法打开立体房间。你可以保存空房间，直接观看后面的短片。
entries.en: This device cannot open the little 3D room. You can save an empty layout and still watch the film.

entries.zh: 也许有一天，也许会是第 2000 天，我们已经拥有了一个自己的家。
entries.en: Maybe one day, maybe on day 2000, we will already have a home of our own.

entries.zh:
我们已经有属于自己的两百天了，
我想第两千天可能也并不遥远吧。

也许有一天，也许会是第 2000 天，
我们已经拥有了一个自己的家。

我的小臭猫。
entries.en:
We already have two hundred days that belong to us,
and I don’t think day two thousand is that far away.

Maybe one day, maybe on day 2000,
we will already have a home of our own.

My little stinky cat.
This page is still being made.
